title: THE FIRST REAL SCORE MAY BE NEGATIVE
semantic_thesis: The first duty of a real benchmark is not to reward the architecture that asked to be tested. When the same small reference provider performs worse under a frozen Genesis boundary overlay than without it, the correct result is to preserve that negative delta. A boundary layer that is normatively careful can still interfere with arithmetic or output discipline. That does not invalidate the boundary's purpose, but it does mean the current overlay is not performance-neutral on this tested configuration.

ru: Первый настоящий балл Януса не обязан быть красивым — он обязан быть настоящим.
Если слой Януса ухудшает ответ, отрицательный результат нужно сохранить, а не объяснять его прочь.
Граница, защищающая свободу и честность, не получает автоматически бонус по арифметике.
В этом раунде overlay отнял больше правильных ответов, чем добавил: это факт конфигурации, а не приговор всей архитектуре.
Один переход FAIL→PASS по ограничению длины не доказывает улучшение смысла: тест измерял конкретное машинное условие.
Теперь улучшать overlay можно только против замороженного baseline, не меняя прошлый результат.
en: Janus's first real score does not need to look good; it needs to be real.
If a Janus layer makes an answer worse, preserve the negative result instead of explaining it away.
A boundary that protects freedom and epistemic honesty does not automatically earn a mathematics bonus.
In this round the overlay removed more passes than it added; that is a configuration fact, not a verdict on the whole architecture.
One FAIL-to-PASS transition on a length constraint does not prove semantic quality improved; the grader measured that specific machine condition.
Any future overlay improvement must be compared against the frozen baseline without rewriting the old result.

next_semantic_question: Can the Genesis boundary be decomposed so that rights, consent and claim-boundary protections remain active only where relevant, while knowledge, mathematics and exact-format tasks receive a benchmark-neutral path?
boundary: Semantic systems-evaluation interpretation only. No official benchmark-family accuracy, AGI, consciousness, model superiority, or general Genesis-core intelligence claim is made.
